issues.desc: CHK-004 verification is broad even though the rename likely touches Codex/Claude adapter assets and agent templates that currently reference @koala-agent/core. If those assets are changed, the checklist/verification intent should explicitly include the project-mandated node bin/lattice.js verify_codex check, instead of relying only on generic runtime contract or lattice validate wording.
